title: A delta^2-L^3 Sensitivity Law for Finite-Window Weil Positivity, with a Function-Field Control of the Connes-van Suijlekom Pipeline
description:
A quantitative sensitivity analysis of the finite-window Weil quadratic form used in the Connes-van Suijlekom and Connes-Consani-Moscovici programs, calibrated against curves over finite fields, where the window form is exactly the Hallouin-Perret Frobenius Gram matrix and the Riemann hypothesis is Weil's theorem. Main result: a delta^2 sensitivity law with an L^3 coefficient, proved in the function field and bounded on the zeta side, with the two laws agreeing as (window length)^3/6. The full minimiser pipeline is also run on deliberately planted off-circle spectra.

Non-claims: this work contains no proof or advance of the Riemann hypothesis for zeta. Planted spectra are fabricated diagnostics. Sixteen retractions are logged in the appendix.
